NIKHIL WANKHADE

9372512233 | nikhilw1981@gmail.com

Profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhil-wankhade-31023a46 Stackoverflow: https://stackoverflow.com/cv/nikhil_dev

A dynamic and result-oriented techno-functional professional with over 13+ years of progressive experience in software development, with a strong grasp of emerging technologies and a proven track record of delivering scalable, high-performance enterprise applications across diverse domains including Gaming, ITeS, Academia, and Digital Signatures.

Possesses deep expertise in Core Java and Java EE, along with hands-on experience across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC)—from requirement analysis, design, development, unit testing to integration and deployment of multi-tier, distributed systems.

Demonstrates strong proficiency in Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD) methodologies, coupled with a sound understanding of Agile and Scrum frameworks. Adept at managing project planning, estimation, scheduling, and resource allocation, while ensuring on-time delivery and maintaining quality standards.

Recognized for the ability to balance technical and business objectives, seamlessly handling multiple roles and responsibilities. Skilled in mentoring, training, and people management, fostering collaborative team environments that drive innovation and performance.

Known as an excellent communicator and proactive problem-solver, with a passion for continuous learning and delivering value through technology. Frequently provides hands-on support to teams, ensuring both individual and collective success.

Technologies & Frameworks Core Java, Java, J2EE [JCE, JPA, JAXB, EJB, JMS, Executers, JDBC, Collections, Multithreading], Apache Artemis, Hibernate, Microservices, Swagger, SQL, Bouncy Castle, Spring Boot [Web, Security, Data, Gateway, Config, Discovery, Remoting], Resilience4J, Shell Script, Spring Framework Front End JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Angular 16, JQuery, JQueryUI, Jtable, tailwind PKI PKI (Digital Signing), Cryptography, CSR, DSC Issuance, HSM (Safenet & Thales), CRL Generation, AIA, SKI, OpenSSL, Digital Signing & Verification, X509V3 Specification, ECDSA, PKCS7, PKCS7pdf, X.509 CRL (RFC 5280), TSP (RFC 3161), OCSP (RFC 2560), RSA PKCS standards, CMS and CAdES signatures, Hardware Security Modules (HSM), Cryptography, Certificate Life Cycle Management - Issue, Revoke, Renew Database IBM DB2, Postgres, Oracle, MySQL, Mongo, Redis, Kafka Distributed Environment Tomcat, WebSphere, JBOSS EAP, WebLogic, TomEE, OpenEJB, WildFly Development Tools Eclipse, Intellij, Putty, Soap UI, Winscp, Maven, Bitbucket, SVN, Git Repo, PL/SQL Developer, VisiualVM Cloud-CICD Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Microk8s Cluster, Traefik, Bitbucket, Git Actions, Workflow, Runner, EFK Stack, GCP, AWS, AZURE Operating Systems Windows family, Unix Family, Mac Family

Designed and implemented a full-scale PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) including Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), Certificate Authority (CA), and HSM integration from scratch using Java Cryptography and Bouncy Castle APIs.

Led the end-to-end setup of an on-premises cloud infrastructure, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant deployment for mission-critical applications.

Architected and managed CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation frameworks, accelerating release cycles and ensuring high availability across hybrid cloud and containerized environments.

Mentored cross-functional teams and aligned engineering best practices with business objectives, delivering large-scale solutions on Kubernetes and modern DevOps toolchains (e.g., Helm, Jenkins, EFK).

Drove team alignment with business objectives, mentoring engineers, standardizing best practices, and managing large- scale cloud transformations

Supporting the team with architectural changes, code refactoring, vulnerability patching and Java upgrade

Managing a high-performance team through coaching and retraining top talents

Built a scalable infrastructure capable of processing over 1.2 million real-time transactions per day with >90% uptime and enhanced fault tolerance.

Enabled high-throughput data processing through implementation of auto-scaling, distributed caching (e.g., Redis), and asynchronous task handling using message queues (Kafka/ActiveMQ).

Implemented centralized observability frameworks (Fluentd, ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana), reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR) by 60%.

Successfully migrated critical systems to in-house cloud infrastructure, leading to a 30% reduction in infrastructure costs and improved governance.

Led Oracle to PostgreSQL migration, transforming 200+ stored procedures, 100+ functions, and complex UDTs with zero downtime



Proteantech Ltd., (formerly NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Ltd) Pune as Senior Manager, Nov 2022 to present. – 2 Year 09 Months

Persistent Systems Ltd., Senior Engineering Lead, March 2022 to Nov 2022. – 09 Months

NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Ltd., Pune as Manager, April 2017 to March 2022. – 4 Years 11 Months NSDL National Database Management Ltd., Pune as Manager, Feb 2014 to April 2017 – 3 Years 3 Months PC Techknowldge Center Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai as Software Engineer, May 2013 to Jan 2014 – 9 Months

Anka Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Pune as Software Engineer, June 2012 to May 2013 – 1 Year

ESIGN

Description: India’s first home-grown large-scale application, eSign service is an online electronic signature service that can facilitate an Aadhaar holder to digitally sign a document. NSDL e-Gov. infrastructure Ltd, a licensed CA is empanelled by CCA to provide eSign services to application service provider (ASP). Enable user to create new CSR, Certificates, CRL and various CRUD operation in HSM hardware security modules. Meerkat supports Gemelto Safenet and Thales brands.

Technologies: Java 8, JCE, Spring Remoting, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Microservices, Restful API, Postgres, Angular JS, JAXB, XML Digital Signatures, PKI, X509 Standards, Cryptography, HSM, Bouncy Castle, Spring Security, JPA, Hibernate, Apache Tomcat, Servlet, JSP, JSTL, DB UDT, PDF Box

Role and Responsibilities:

Need to work with product owner, understand requirements and estimate the requirement

SOA architecture design and implementation

Design database and basic project stack

Design prototype of requirement and sequence diagram of the flow

Individual contributor for coding, testing and deployment

Developed eSign Realm Application, TSA (Time Stamping Authority), Meerkat HSM Utility for key management

Need to do backend and frontend changes for the feature requirement

Troubleshoot and resolve production issues using different tools VisiualVM, PGbagger etc.

Need to write Database UDT, stored procedures, indexes, functions and views etc.

EDASTAKHAT

Description: eDastakhat is an online electronic signature platform that can facilitate an Aadhaar holder to digitally sign a document through electronic signature provider (ESP). Provides hassle-free registration and payment and eSign.

Technologies: Java 11, Spring Boot, Microservices, Postgres, Angular 11, XML Digital Signatures, Spring [Security, Boot, Data, Cloud, Gateway, Config Server, Authorisation Server, Discovery Server], Postgres, Apache Artemis, PDF Box

Role and Responsibilities:

Work with product owner, understand requirements and estimate the requirement

Design Microservice Architecture

Design database and basic project stack/code-base

Design prototype of requirement and sequence diagram of the flow

Individual contributor for coding, testing and deployment (UAT & PROD)

Need to do backend and frontend changes for the feature requirement

Need to handle team members, support and guide them

OFFLINE ESIGN

Description: Digital signing using offline Aadhaar, PAN, Bank KYC, Organizational KYC. Download signed document, check transaction and user management process. User can register & avail this service by downloading his offline XML from UADAI site.

Technologies: Java 8, JSP, Servlet, Spring Remoting, Spring MVC, HTML, CSS, Hibernate, Postgres, XML Digital Signatures, Spring Security, PDF Standards, Docker, Python Service, Eclipse, Apache Tomcat

Role and Responsibilities:

Need to work with product owner, understand requirements and estimate the requirement

Designed SOA architecture

Design database and basic project stack

Design prototype, data model and sequence diagram of the flow

Individual contributor for coding, testing and deployment (UAT & PROD)

Deliver backend and frontend changes for the feature requirement

Involve in all activity in analysis, design, development, unit testing & integration till production

BECKN

Description: Beckn is an open-source protocol that enables location-aware, local commerce across industries to be discovered and engaged by any beckn-enabled application. Beckn provides consumers the freedom to discover commerce service including day-to-day services like mobility, food and grocery delivery in any consumer facing application of choice that is backend enabled, thereby, making it a one-stop place for availing commerce services.



Technologies: Java 11, Spring Boot, Microservices, Postgres, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud [Gateway, Config Server, Authorisation Server, Resource Server, Discovery Server], Resilience4J, Eclipse, Swagger

Role and Responsibilities:

Need to work with product owner, understand requirements do analysis and estimate the requirement

Design Microservice Architecture, Implement network security Key Agreement with Curve25519, ED25519

Design database, sequence diagram and basic project stack

Design prototype of requirement

Individual contributor for coding, testing and deployment (UAT)

EWAYBILL

Description: NSDL will consume NIC eWay bill API and provide a wrapper API to generate and track unique eWay bill number for movement of goods is easy way.

Technologies: Java 8, Spring MVC, Spring AOP, Spring Security, Postgres, Resilience4J, Eclipse, SOAP UI

Role and Responsibilities:

Gathering and understand requirements, estimate and effort estimation

Design SOA Architecture

Need to API design, documentation using Swagger tool

Need to design database and basic project stack

Involve in all activity including analysis, development, unit testing and taking it out to the production

Individual contributor for coding, testing and deployment (UAT and PROD)

Need to do backend and frontend changes for the feature requirement

GSP-ASP GST SOLUTION

Description: NSDL e-Gov is a GST Suvidha provider appointed by GSTN for implementing GST across the country. NSDL e-Gov also offers application service provider services to the users.

Technologies: Java 8, Spring Boot, Spring Data, JPA(Mongo and Hibernate), Microservices, Mongo DB, Restful API, ,Angular JS, Spring Config Server and Client, Rest Template, Eureka Server and Client, Feign, Spring Cloud Hystrix, Bulkhead Pattern, AOP, Multithreading, Spark and Kafka.

Role and Responsibilities:

Need to work with product owner and understand requirements

Design Basic Code Base and Architecture for the proposed system

Design prototype of requirement and sequence diagram of the flow

Need to do backend and frontend changes for the feature requirement

NSR - NATIONAL SKILLS REGISTRY

Description: National Skills Registry is a NASSCOM initiative to have a robust and credible information repository about all persons working in the industry. All profiles are verified by registered background checks and registered with the biometric data.

Technologies: Java7, JavaEE, Java Mail, Hibernate 3, EJB, JMS, JBoss EAP, Oracle11g, SOA, JPF, Pageflow NetUI

Role and Responsibilities:

Involved in designing JSP pages and map them to spring models

Design basic JSP UI with CSS and HTML

Individual contributor for coding, testing and deployment

Delivered continuous change request and bug fixes

Creates and maintain background Jobs in Oracle DB

MCA (Master of Computer Application) from the University of SGBAU, Amravati, Maharashtra, India in 2012 with 64%

Certification in Hand on Microservices

Certification in Hands on Angular11 and Typescript

Kubernetes In Google Cloud ID:10463812

ESIGN
Description: India’s first home-grown large-scale application, eSign service is an online electronic signature service that can facilitate an Aadhaar holder to digitally sign a document. NSDL e-Gov. infrastructure Ltd, a licensed CA is empanelled by CCA to provide eSign services to application service provider (ASP). Enable user to create new CSR, Certificates, CRL and various CRUD operation in HSM hardware security modules. Meerkat supports Gemelto Safenet and Thales brands.
Technologies: Java 8, JCE, Spring Remoting, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Microservices, Restful API, Postgres, Angular JS, JAXB, XML Digital Signatures, PKI, X509 Standards, Cryptography, HSM, Bouncy Castle, Spring Security, JPA, Hibernate, Apache Tomcat, Servlet, JSP, JSTL, DB UDT, PDF Box
Role and Responsibilities:
Need to work with product owner, understand requirements and estimate the requirement
SOA architecture design and implementation
Design database and basic project stack
Design prototype of requirement and sequence diagram of the flow
Individual contributor for coding, testing and deployment
Developed eSign Realm Application, TSA (Time Stamping Authority), Meerkat HSM Utility for key management
Need to do backend and frontend changes for the feature requirement
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues using different tools VisiualVM, PGbagger etc.
Need to write Database UDT, stored procedures, indexes, functions and views etc.
EDASTAKHAT
Description: eDastakhat is an online electronic signature platform that can facilitate an Aadhaar holder to digitally sign a document through electronic signature provider (ESP). Provides hassle-free registration and payment and eSign.
Technologies: Java 11, Spring Boot, Microservices, Postgres, Angular 11, XML Digital Signatures, Spring [Security, Boot, Data, Cloud, Gateway, Config Server, Authorisation Server, Discovery Server], Postgres, Apache Artemis, PDF Box
Role and Responsibilities:
Work with product owner, understand requirements and estimate the requirement
Design Microservice Architecture
Design database and basic project stack/code-base
Design prototype of requirement and sequence diagram of the flow
Individual contributor for coding, testing and deployment (UAT & PROD)
Need to do backend and frontend changes for the feature requirement
Need to handle team members, support and guide them
OFFLINE ESIGN
Description: Digital signing using offline Aadhaar, PAN, Bank KYC, Organizational KYC. Download signed document, check transaction and user management process. User can register & avail this service by downloading his offline XML from UADAI site.
Technologies: Java 8, JSP, Servlet, Spring Remoting, Spring MVC, HTML, CSS, Hibernate, Postgres, XML Digital Signatures, Spring Security, PDF Standards, Docker, Python Service, Eclipse, Apache Tomcat
Role and Responsibilities:
Need to work with product owner, understand requirements and estimate the requirement
Designed SOA architecture
Design database and basic project stack
Design prototype, data model and sequence diagram of the flow
Individual contributor for coding, testing and deployment (UAT & PROD)
Deliver backend and frontend changes for the feature requirement
Involve in all activity in analysis, design, development, unit testing & integration till production
BECKN
Description: Beckn is an open-source protocol that enables location-aware, local commerce across industries to be discovered and engaged by any beckn-enabled application. Beckn provides consumers the freedom to discover commerce service including day-to-day services like mobility, food and grocery delivery in any consumer facing application of choice that is backend enabled, thereby, making it a one-stop place for availing commerce services.
Technologies: Java 11, Spring Boot, Microservices, Postgres, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud [Gateway, Config Server, Authorisation Server, Resource Server, Discovery Server], Resilience4J, Eclipse, Swagger
Role and Responsibilities:
Need to work with product owner, understand requirements do analysis and estimate the requirement
Design Microservice Architecture, Implement network security Key Agreement with Curve25519, ED25519
Design database, sequence diagram and basic project stack
Design prototype of requirement
Individual contributor for coding, testing and deployment (UAT)
EWAYBILL
Description: NSDL will consume NIC eWay bill API and provide a wrapper API to generate and track unique eWay bill number for movement of goods is easy way.
Technologies: Java 8, Spring MVC, Spring AOP, Spring Security, Postgres, Resilience4J, Eclipse, SOAP UI

Design SOA Architecture
Need to API design, documentation using Swagger tool
Need to design database and basic project stack
Involve in all activity including analysis, development, unit testing and taking it out to the production

Need to do backend and frontend changes for the feature requirement
